verdict.rationale: Aleph documents drill-down within its Excel and Google Sheets reporting workflows, a single source of truth that feeds reports, and AI agent answers with clickable cited sources that trace back to that source of truth. That is the product's own traceability capability, but the evidence is marketing-level and mostly tied to agent answers rather than to every report number. Missing for 10: tracing a report number through its formulas or calculation logic, drill-down to individual source transaction lines, depth documentation of the drill-down feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
